text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install a pedestrian crossover (PXO) on Wellington Street West at Stanley Terrace. This PXO would provide a protected crossing for pedestrians and cyclists across Wellington Street West. This PXO will compliment the new pedestrian/cyclist bridges and a path to the south of Wellington Street West, and would also provide a link between the Stanley Park area, Fort York, The Bentway and the waterfront trails.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of a pedestrian crossover (PXO) on Wellington Street West at Stanley Terrace.
